_comment: TEMPLATE — copy to profile/candidate.json and fill in your own details. profile/candidate.json is gitignored and never committed. The job agent feeds this to the LLM so it can judge whether a posting genuinely fits and draft an application email in your real voice.
name: Your Full Name
headline: One-line pitch used in email openers, e.g. 'AI Solutions & Automation Engineer — I build autonomous agents that run with little to no supervision.'

preferences.locationPreference: Where you want to work. This drives the search queries, so be specific — e.g. 'Remote, global. Prefers roles open to applicants outside the EU/US.'

targetRoles: The job titles worth flagging. The agent matches loosely —
a posting does not need the exact title, just the same kind of work.
strengths: Proof points the email draft can pull from. Concrete beats abstract:
name the system you built, what it does, and link a demo if you have one.
education: Degree, class of honours, institution. Add any study in progress.
dealbreakers: Hard filters the agent respects when judging fit, e.g.
'Skip roles requiring on-site presence with no remote option.'
